new_findings.title: gem5 SE loader rejects a byte-aligned .bss sub-segment
new_findings.note: lld leaves p_filesz byte-aligned, so the uninitialised sub-segment starts at p_vaddr + p_filesz (e.g. 0x53de6); QEMU user loads the same ELF.  Byte-addressable .bss needs no word alignment, so this is a loader restriction, not a guest defect.  Ledger id not allocated (out of this task file's range).
